acceptance.gate_policy: budgets fixed before execution; preserve failed attempts and original expectations before any correction; no loosen-after-failure
acceptance.identities_and_masks: exact all-eight row order, one grid, four curves, channel/event order, state IDs/masses, source origin, epoch/support, coverage/full duration, detector units, requested/omitted groups survive receipts

independent_frequency_vs_polynomial_and_.formula: abs(frequency64_N-polynomial_N)+earned_frequency64_absolute_error+earned_polynomial_absolute_error<=1e-300+2e-13*abs(polynomial_N); 32/64 difference plus both earned errors uses the same fixed2e-13 relative allocation

acceptance.independent_high_precision_arithmetic_re: 60 decimal-digit arithmetic: reserve1e-50*(1+abs(quantity)) in each computed high-precision scalar coordinate, add refinement difference and Gaussian-envelope tail where applicable; preserve each reservation and transformation. This empirical arithmetic reservation is far below fixed budgets and must be earned by the declared refinement control.

native_joint_event_selected_logs_vs_inde.formula: abs(native_log-reference_log)+earned_reference_log_error<=2e-10*(1+abs(reference_log)); joint numerator, event and selected each have separate earned errors

acceptance.photon_endpoint_ancestry: This is an empirical control allocation, not a universal rigorous temporal certificate. Apply lower nextafter(N*(1-3.2e-12),0) and upper nextafter(N*(1+3.2e-12),+infinity); compare native log changes and retain all endpoint failures. The base durations 2 and 3 are exact binary64, so this control has zero dark-duration casting error; any future arbitrary-duration composition requires an explicit dark-duration sensitivity contract.
acceptance.photon_endpoint_relative_empirical_alloc: 3.2e-12 = sampled empirical 3e-12 + temporal mean admission 1e-13 + duration admission 1e-13
acceptance.reference_error_rule: Convert refined positive density/CDF/probability errors, analytic Gaussian truncation bounds and high-precision arithmetic reservation into each actual log coordinate. For a positive mixture M with earned absolute error delta<M, log error is -log1p(-delta/M); selected error includes both numerator and event allocations. Charge earned error to the same fixed comparison budget, never append it outside the allowance.
acceptance.selection_identity: reported selected log equals reported joint log minus same reported ALL-four-detected event log within stated allocation

authorization.execution_gate: Contract hash and independent source-only review accepted by root, then one explicit local compiler/compute lease
authorization.scope: ignored experiment and evidence only; no production interface, public Reproducible files, source assets or frozen SDK modifications

detector.conditional_independence: Poisson arrivals and Gaussian read errors mutually independent across disjoint four readouts, conditional on the one common optical state; separate record controls are alternative data, never multiplied as extra measurements
detector.endpoint_request_policy: nominal and both photon-sensitivity endpoints retain complete original records plus threshold-only nondetection probes, all under same detector policy; count every Poisson term and required failure Compute N +/- empirical allocation in long double, cast to binary64 then directed nextafter. Required positive endpoints must be normal and finite or retain an outside_domain refusal. For an exact N=0 witness skip endpoint calls; never manufacture a positive subnormal endpoint.
detector.event_definition: ALL four channels detected: Y_c>=1.5 ADU for every c; zero-noise K_c>=1
detector.origin: synthetic fixed electron-arrival and readout parameters
detector.per_sigma_batch: For each fixed sigma=0 or3/4 and each state/channel: three original rows (joint all-detected, selected-control numerator all-detected, joint censored), followed by three threshold-only nondetection probes; exactly6 rows. Every original and probe Observation measure is joint_detection_record. Only the external reducer applies selected-only ALL-four conditioning once.

external_reducer.arithmetic: long double positive mixture/log accumulation; explicitly retained structural zero and failed status
external_reducer.correlation_algebra: M_joint-M_E0*M_E1=p0*p1*(q_S0,E0-q_S1,E0)*(q_S0,E1-q_S1,E1), where q is the within-exposure conditional product. ALL-detected event q can coincide under state-swap symmetry; here effective unattenuated blue/red electron signal ratios51/58 and276/307 are near symmetry and do not prove a1e-3 event lower bound.
external_reducer.correlation_witness: Compare common-state four-channel L with product over exposures of separately marginalized two-channel L. Numerator absolute relative difference must exceed1e-3 in at least one declared sigma control as synthetic experiment success criterion, not a proved theorem or engine correctness requirement. Always report same-event signed/relative differences and earned reference errors, and require shared-event denominator/reference agreement without an invented minimum event dependence.
external_reducer.covariance_interpretation: off-diagonal readout covariance is Cov_p(lambda_s,i,lambda_s,j)/(g_i*g_j); mixture retains that shared dependence without injecting a Gaussian covariance or extra noise
external_reducer.diagnostic_rule: sum conditional band log diagnostics, transfer photon endpoint differences, then weighted positive-mixture relative diagnostics with rounding ancestry; joint numerator and event have distinct gates, selected allocation includes both All native/endpoint/mixture diagnostics are empirical controls, not a universal rigorous numerical certificate.
external_reducer.failure_behavior: required nominal or endpoint refusal withholds joint/event/selected outputs, preserving all raw attempts, states/masses and row identities; selected-only containing nondetection is refused
external_reducer.selected_equation: L_selected(data)=L(data)/P(ALL_detected) only for an all-detected record

positive_read_noise.tail_allocation: Gaussian envelope bounds density tail gain*exp(-sigma^2*T^2/2)/(pi*sigma^2*T), CDF tail exp(-sigma^2*T^2/2)/(pi*sigma^2*T^2); at sigma=3/4 and T=24 the exponent is -162
